pkgmetadata.longdescription:
NEC's RT (runtime-test) monitor for the SX-Aurora TSUBASA MMM stack: the rtmon engine plus the runtime test catalog (cata_default), RT.par parameters and the per-slot interrupt seeds under /var/opt/nec/ve/td/rt/. ve_monitor executes rtmon per the mmm .config td_rt_exec setting.
Split out of the vendor's mmm RPM family exactly as upstream ships it (rtmon is a separate RPM from mmm).
